title: LED Lighting & Smart Switch Retrofit
description: Replace standard fluorescent tube bulbs with energy-efficient LED fixtures and motion sensors in warehouses, hospital supply zones, and office facilities.
descriptionId: Mengganti lampu neon konvensional dengan lampu LED hemat energi dan sensor gerak otomatis di area gudang, zona logistik rumah sakit, dan perkantoran.
practicalTips: Focus first on high-usage areas like sorting floors and continuous lighting corridors.
Check local energy utility rebates for business LED retrofits.
Take before/after photos of installed fixture labels for proof.
practicalTipsId: Prioritaskan area dengan jam operasional tinggi seperti lantai sortir dan koridor utama.
Pilih lampu LED berlabel hemat energi SNI atau standar internasional.
Ambil foto perbandingan sebelum dan sesudah instalasi sebagai bukti audit.

title: 100% Digital Invoicing & Paperless Workflow
titleId: Faktur Digital 100% & Alur Kerja Tanpa Kertas
description: Transition customer delivery notes, purchase orders, medical supply manifests, and supplier invoices to digital PDF & electronic signing.
descriptionId: Mengalihkan surat jalan pengiriman, purchase order, manifes pasokan medis, dan faktur tagihan ke format digital PDF dengan tanda tangan elektronik resmi.
practicalTips: Enable e-signatures on mobile tablets for delivery drivers and receiving staff.
Set printer default to double-sided and black & white only.
Export monthly print log summary as verification document.
practicalTipsId: Aktifkan tanda tangan digital pada tablet kurir pengantar dan staf penerima barang.
Kunci pengaturan default printer menjadi bolak-balik (duplex) dan hitam-putih.
Unduh laporan rekap log cetak bulanan sebagai dokumen verifikasi.

title: Eliminate Single-Use Plastic Wrapping & Packaging
titleId: Penghapusan Plastik Sekali Pakai & Kemasan Ramah Lingkungan
description: Replace plastic bubble wrap with recycled paper honeycomb cushioning and provide reusable stainless steel water tumblers to all operational staff.
descriptionId: Mengganti bubble wrap plastik dengan bantalan kertas sarang lebah (honeycomb) daur ulang dan menyediakan tumbler baja tahan karat untuk seluruh staf.
practicalTips: Install refillable water dispenser stations in warehouse break rooms.
Source shredded recycled cardboard padding for carton parcel shipping.
Snap photos of new eco-cushioning packaging materials.
practicalTipsId: Sediakan stasiun air minum isi ulang di ruang istirahat staf gudang.
Gunakan cacahan kardus daur ulang sebagai bantalan pengaman pengiriman boks.
Foto kemasan ramah lingkungan yang mulai digunakan saat pengiriman barang.

title: Supply Chain Waste Stream Sorting & Circular Recycling
titleId: Pemilahan Limbah Rantai Pasok & Daur Ulang Sirkular
description: Partner with certified local waste aggregators to segregate cardboard, scrap metal, and plastic film for 100% traceable circular recycling.
descriptionId: Bekerja sama dengan agregator daur ulang tersertifikasi untuk memilah kardus, logam sisa, dan plastik film hingga 100% terdaur ulang secara terlacak.
practicalTips: Place clearly color-coded collection bins across operational zones.
Keep weigh-bridge waste collection manifests from your recycling partner.
practicalTipsId: Sediakan tempat sampah terpilah dengan kode warna jelas di setiap zona operasional.
Simpan bukti timbang dan berita acara pengangkutan dari mitra daur ulang resmi.

title: Ecosystem Coastal Mangrove & Tree Planting Initiative
titleId: Program Penanaman Pohon Mangrove & Konservasi Pesisir
description: Sponsor and participate in community coastal mangrove restoration to absorb carbon, protect shoreline biodiversity, and empower local fishermen.
descriptionId: Mensponsori dan berpartisipasi dalam restorasi mangrove pesisir untuk menyerap karbon, melindungi keanekaragaman hayati, dan memberdayakan nelayan lokal.
practicalTips: Involve employees in a weekend volunteer planting event.
Obtain official tree planting certificate from local conservation NGO.
practicalTipsId: Libatkan perwakilan karyawan dalam kegiatan penanaman sukarela di akhir pekan.
Minta sertifikat penanaman resmi dan koordinat lokasi bibit dari LSM konservasi.

title: Low-Flow Tap Aerators & Rainwater Harvesting System
titleId: Pemasangan Aerator Kran Hemat Air & Penampungan Air Hujan
description: Install water-saving aerators on all facility faucets and harvest rainwater for vehicle fleet washing and landscape maintenance.
descriptionId: Memasang aerator penghemat air pada kran fasilitas operasional dan menampung air hujan untuk pencucian armada kendaraan serta penyiraman taman.
practicalTips: Low-cost tap aerators reduce flow rate by up to 50% without lowering pressure.
Log monthly water meter readings before and after installation.
practicalTipsId: Aerator kran ekonomis dapat menghemat debit air hingga 50% tanpa mengurangi tekanan.
Catat meteran air bulanan sebelum dan sesudah instalasi untuk melihat penurunan konsumsi.

title: Solar PV Rooftop Installation & Clean Energy Adoption
titleId: Instalasi Panel Surya Atap (Solar PV) & Energi Bersih
description: Install on-grid or hybrid solar photovoltaic panels on warehouse rooftops to offset grid electricity with on-site zero-emission power.
descriptionId: Memasang panel surya fotovoltaik di atap gudang atau kantor cabang untuk menyuplai energi bersih terbarukan dan mengurangi emisi karbon.
practicalTips: Conduct structural rooftop load assessment prior to mounting.
Install bidirectional net-metering with PLN or local electricity provider.
practicalTipsId: Lakukan uji beban struktur atap sebelum memasang modul panel surya.
Gunakan inverter bergaransi resmi dan daftarkan net-metering ke penyedia listrik.

title: Living Wage & Equal Pay Policy Audit
titleId: Audit Kebijakan Upah Layak & Kesetaraan Kompensasi
description: Formalize a written policy guaranteeing wages above regional minimum threshold and ensuring equal compensation for equal work across all genders.
descriptionId: Mengesahkan kebijakan tertulis yang menjamin upah di atas standar minimum regional (UMR) serta kesetaraan gaji untuk pekerjaan yang setara.
practicalTips: Compare lowest operational salaries against certified regional living wage benchmarks.
Upload HR policy excerpt or director sign-off memo.
practicalTipsId: Bandingkan struktur gaji terendah dengan tolok ukur standar upah hidup layak resmi.
Unggah salinan SK Direksi atau kutipan kebijakan HRD yang telah ditandatangani.

title: Comprehensive Workplace Safety & First Aid Training
description: Conduct mandatory safety protocol refresher, hazard identification, and certified first aid training for warehouse operators and drivers.
descriptionId: Menyelenggarakan pelatihan penyegaran protokol K3 berkala, identifikasi bahaya kerja, dan sertifikasi pertolongan pertama (P3K) bagi seluruh staf operasional.
practicalTips: Conduct practical fire extinguisher drill and helmet/boot compliance check.
Upload signed attendance sheet and training certificate.
practicalTipsId: Lakukan simulasi pemadaman APAR praktis dan pemeriksaan kelengkapan APD.
Unggah daftar hadir bertanda tangan dan sertifikat pelatihan K3 resmi.

title: Local Vocational Youth Mentorship & Healthcare Internship
titleId: Program Mentorship Vokasi SMK & Magang Logistik Medis
description: Provide supply chain & digital healthcare technology mentorship workshops and paid apprenticeships for local vocational high school students.
descriptionId: Menyediakan program lokakarya mentorship rantai pasok dan magang kerja berbayar bagi siswa-siswi SMK kejuruan di sekitar area operasional.
practicalTips: Partner with 1 local vocational school for a 4-week internship shadowing track.
Take group photo with students and upload school partner letter.
practicalTipsId: Bekerja sama dengan 1 SMK mitra untuk program magang terstruktur selama minimal 4 minggu.
Dokumentasikan foto kegiatan mentoring dan unggah MoU kerja sama dengan pihak sekolah.

title: Code of Ethics & Anti-Corruption Governance Policy
titleId: Tata Kelola Kode Etik, Anti-Suap & Saluran Pelaporan Whistleblower
description: Implement a zero-tolerance anti-bribery policy, conflict of interest declarations, and confidential whistleblower channel accessible to all suppliers.
descriptionId: Menerapkan kebijakan anti-penyuapan berprinsip toleransi nol, deklarasi benturan kepentingan, serta saluran pelaporan pelanggaran (whistleblower) rahasia.
practicalTips: Set up a dedicated email box or web form for anonymous reporting.
Ensure 100% of new hires acknowledge the code of conduct during onboarding.
practicalTipsId: Siapkan kanal pengaduan anonim independen (email/hotline khusus).
Pastikan seluruh karyawan baru menandatangani pakta integritas saat orientasi.

title: Medical Data Protection & Cybersecurity Hardening
titleId: Perlindungan Data Medis & Penguatan Keamanan Siber
description: Establish clear customer data privacy guidelines complying with Indonesian PDP laws, enforce two-factor authentication (2FA), and conduct annual security audits.
descriptionId: Menetapkan pedoman kepatuhan UU Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP), mewajibkan otentikasi dua faktor (2FA), dan melakukan audit keamanan siber tahunan.
practicalTips: Enforce strong password policy and auto-screen lock on company laptops.
Upload cybersecurity completion certificate from internal portal.
practicalTipsId: Terapkan kebijakan password kompleks dan auto-lock layar pada perangkat kantor.
Unggah sertifikat hasil evaluasi kesadaran siber (cybersecurity awareness) tahunan.
